verdict: Ads are driving clicks; a tracking disconnect is hiding your leads.
narrative: Google Ads delivered 66 tracked conversions from 289 clicks on $156.35 in spend this period, so traffic is real and moving. However, zero leads are showing up in your intake system — the data points to a form or connection issue between your ads and your CRM, not a drop in ad performance. We've identified the disconnect and are repairing it now; until it's resolved, your true cost per lead can't be calculated. On the organic side, both Canton and Fishers locations stayed active with strong direction and call volume this period, though Google Business Profile engagement softened in the back half of the window — posting and review cadence will be tightened to stabilize that. Expect lead flow to become visible in the system once the tracking repair is complete this week.
